Name: Dominical Beach (Playa Dominical)
Address_or_area: Playa Dominical, Distrito Bahía Ballena, Cantón Osa, Provincia de Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Long Pacific beach along Route 34 south of Quepos, known for consistent surf and a laid-back traveler scene.

Name: Marino Ballena National Park (Whale's Tail sector)
Address_or_area: Entrada Sector Uvita, Parque Nacional Marino Ballena, Uvita de Osa, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Marine national park protecting humpback whales and coastal ecosystems; features the Punta Uvita 'Whale's Tail' tombolo visible at low tide.

Name: Playa Uvita / Whale's Tail viewpoint
Address_or_area: Beach access via Sector Uvita entrance, Uvita, Bahía Ballena, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Main beach inside the park where you can walk out along the Whale's Tail sandbar at low tide with views back to forested hills.

Name: Costa Ballena coastal strip
Address_or_area: Route 34 corridor between Dominical, Uvita and Ojochal, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Narrow coastal plain with surf beaches, river mouths and lowland rainforest; visible as you ride south along Route 34.

Name: Palmar Norte town center
Address_or_area: Centro de Palmar Norte, Cantón Osa, Provincia de Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Small but busy town at junction of Route 34 and Route 2 (Pan-American Highway); gateway to Osa Peninsula and Térraba–Sierpe wetlands.

Name: Térraba–Sierpe Wetlands access (Palmar Sur–Sierpe road)
Address_or_area: Cruce a Palmar Sur y Sierpe,  Parque Nacional Humedal Nacional Térraba-Sierpe, cerca de Palmar Norte, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Junction toward Palmar Sur and Sierpe, where boats depart into the Térraba–Sierpe National Wetlands and onward to Osa and Corcovado.

Name: San Vito town center
Address_or_area: Parque Central de San Vito, Distrito San Vito, Cantón Coto Brus, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Highland town founded as an Italian agricultural colony; compact center with park, church, and local cafés in a cool climate.

Name: Dante Alighieri Cultural Center
Address_or_area: Frente al Parque Central, San Vito de Coto Brus, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Small cultural center documenting Italian immigration to Coto Brus; displays and historical context for the town's origins.

Name: Las Cruces Biological Station & Wilson Botanical Garden
Address_or_area: Estación Biológica Las Cruces y Jardín Botánico Wilson, 6–7 km al sur de San Vito por Ruta 237, Coto Brus, Costa Rica
Description: Organization for Tropical Studies (OTS) research station with extensive botanical collections and forest trails; excellent for plants and birding.

Name: Río Sereno – San Vito border crossing (Costa Rica side)
Address_or_area: Puesto Fronterizo San Vito–Río Sereno, Las Mellizas, Cantón Coto Brus, Puntarenas, Costa Rica
Description: Quiet highland border post between Costa Rica and Panama reached via rural coffee roads; basic facilities and minimal truck traffic.

Name: Río Sereno border village (Panama side)
Address_or_area: Pueblo de Río Sereno, Distrito Renacimiento, Provincia de Chiriquí, Panamá
Description: Small Panamanian border village with immigration/customs offices, a few stores and cafés along the main street.

Name: Volcán town center
Address_or_area: Centro de Volcán, Distrito Tierras Altas, Provincia de Chiriquí, Panamá
Description: Cool highland town on the flank of Volcán Barú, serving as an agricultural and services hub for surrounding farms and villages.

Name: Highland farms around Volcán
Address_or_area: Carretera Volcán–Cerro Punta and surrounding rural roads, Tierras Altas, Chiriquí, Panamá
Description: Mosaic of vegetable farms, dairy operations and coffee fincas on volcanic soils, with views toward surrounding ridges.

Name: Volcán Barú National Park (general access area)
Address_or_area: Parque Nacional Volcán Barú, Provincia de Chiriquí, Panamá (main road access from Boquete and highland roads from Tierras Altas)
Description: Protected area encompassing Panama's highest volcano and several highland ecosystems; summit hikes and 4×4 tours typically organized from Boquete or highland towns.

Name: Lagunas de Volcán / nearby wetlands
Address_or_area: Lagunas y humedales cercanos a Volcán, Tierras Altas, Provincia de Chiriquí, Panamá
Description: Small lakes and wetlands near Volcán offering short walks, birdwatching and cool-climate scenery.

Name: Coffee farm / tasting rooms (generic entry)
Address_or_area: Various fincas cafetaleras around Volcán and Cerro Punta, Tierras Altas, Chiriquí, Panamá
Description: High-elevation coffee farms on volcanic soils; many offer tours and tastings showcasing specialty and geisha coffees from the Chiriquí Highlands.
